headline: Meta Reports Surging Q3 Profit as Ad Revenue and Muse Demand Rise
summary: Meta Platforms reported a more than threefold jump in third-quarter profit as revenue climbed sharply, while noting strong interest in its Muse personal assistant.
why: Meta Platforms operates major social media networks like Facebook and Instagram, generating vast digital advertising revenue alongside investments in AI technologies.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Strong third-quarter earnings and rapid user adoption of new AI-driven features boosted investor confidence.

why_moved: A sharp rise in quarterly profit and strong adoption metrics for AI products beat consensus estimates, driving buying interest in Meta shares.
